basic_info.description: This is an opportunity to have it your way.  A true blank slate in dynamic Downtown high-rise this NE corner condo with great light has textured views of Nob Hill, FiDi and Downtown skyline from wrap around windows. Build equity by renovating this one bedroom condo with two full bathrooms. Mostly original. Potential to close in the alcove area for a 2nd bedroom like #720 that just sold.  Minutes to shopping, dining, theatre and entertainment. La Galleria is an amenity building featuring 24/7 attended lobby, outdoor pool open & heated seasonally, fully equipped gym, recently renovated laundry facility and parking.
